applicable_when: The kernel launches only 1 CTA total (grid=(1,1,1)) on a 132-SM H200. The batch dimension is 32,768 (2048x2x8) but grid[1]=1 so only batch slice 0 is ever computed. Additionally, 80 registers/thread caps theoretical occupancy at 37.5% (Block Limit Registers = 6 blocks/SM). Reducing BLOCK_M and BLOCK_N from 64 to 32 cuts register usage per thread (tile accumulator shrinks from 64x64 to 32x32), targeting ~40-48 registers/thread and raising Block Limit Registers from 6 to 10+ blocks/SM. The grid must simultaneously be corrected to (4, 32768, 1) so all batch slices are processed. Together these changes turn 1 active CTA into 131,072 CTAs spread across 132 SMs (~993 waves).
